input.relationship: src/weights.ts#entryWeight value-reference src/weights.ts#allocationWeight (backward); src/weights.ts#allocationWeight call src/lru.ts#admittedAllocation (backward)

evidence.reason: Refactored from inline header/byteUnit logic to weightDetails(...).bytes; behavior depends on weightDetails preserving image=64/text=24 headers and byteUnit multiplication.
Referenced by entryWeight and called by lru.ts admittedAllocation and set; must remain compatible with (bytes, overhead, category) signature and return semantics.
New function calls weights.allocationWeight(bytes, 0.1, 'image') / weights.byteUnit; relies on allocationWeight returning byte-scaled value and byteUnit being exported.
Caller uses weights.allocationWeight(bytes, 0.1, 'text') / weights.byteUnit for capacity comparison; any change to allocationWeight semantics affects admission behavior.
Usage shows allocationWeight(bytes, 0.1, 'text') / byteUnit, indicating allocationWeight is expected to return byte-scaled values consistent with byteUnit.

result.userExplanation: entryWeight 重构为委托 weightDetails 后，若 weightDetails 未保留 image=64/text=24 的头部开销与 byteUnit 乘法，会改变 lru.ts 中依赖 allocationWeight 的容量计算行为。
result.suggestedAction: 请 src/weights.ts 的 weightDetails 作者确认并保证其 bytes 返回值与 entryWeight 原逻辑一致（image 头部 64、text 头部 24，并乘以 byteUnit）；若不一致，应修改 weightDetails 或让 entryWeight 保留原计算。
